title: Hall of the Grey Titan
story: The hall of the Grey Titan is situated deep in the wasteland, in uncharted lands. These days it is overrun with monkeys, indifferent to the history of the place.
notes: A massive gate with a keyhole to the south.
A strange, sticky to touch scarf hovering in the middle of the room.
A calm dark priest, lying in a corner.
A key tucked under some debris.
